propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatum Ludovicum Confessorem tuum de terreno regno ad caelestis
regni gloriam transtulisti: ejus, quaesumus, meritis et intercessione; Regis
regum Jesu Christi Filii tui facias nos esse consortes: Qui tecum vivit et
regnat in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, sicut beatus Ludovicus Confessor
tuus, spretis mundi oblectamentis, soli Regi Christo placere studuit; ita
ejus oratio nos tibi reddat acceptos. Per eundem Dominum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Grant, we ask, almighty God, that just as blessed Louis, your Confessor, spurned the world's pleasures and sought to please only Christ the King, so his prayer may make us acceptable to you. Through the same Lord.

defensorem. Per Dominum.
